descriptionChirho: A woman's husband or marital partner, translating as esposo/marido/पति/남편/mume.
The owner or master of an animal, field, house, pit, or other possession, translating as dueño/मालिक/주인/mwenye.

labelChirho: lord or ruler of a city
descriptionChirho: Lords, rulers, or leading citizens of a city or region, translating as señores/स्वामियों/주인들/mabwana.
A possessor or one characterized by a particular attribute, used idiomatically as in 'ba'al of teeth' or 'ba'al of dreams', translating as having/वाला/가진 자.
An ally, confederate, or covenant partner bound in mutual obligation, translating as aliados/सहभगि/동맹자.
A chief, captain, or high official exercising authority over a group, translating as jefe/अध्यक्ष/mkuu.
